scripts.dev: pnpm run prestart:ports && concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix name --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run dev:backend:raw" "pnpm run dev:frontend:raw"

scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm run prestart:frontend && pnpm run dev:frontend:raw
